basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunning, two story townhouse-style condo located near the vibrant amenities of Noe Valley and the Castro. The main level offers stylized open-concept living w/ a spacious family room, cozy fireplace & deck that seamlessly flows into the formal dining area & into the freshly remodeled kitchen w/ newer cabinets, countertops &  backsplash. Equipped w/ newer stainless steel appliances & a kitchen island. This is thee ideal layout for hosting super fun game nights & dinner with your favs. The in unit laundry, entryway closets & thoughtful half bath complete this level. Relax outdoors on either level w/ multiple options including two decks offering amazing bay & city views OR on your private street level patio to enjoy that midday cold brew. The highly coveted three rooms & two full baths on the same level include a primary suite that is both luxurious & generous in size with a walk-in closet & built-in shelving. The ensuite bath offers double sinks, a separate walk-in shower & separate soaking, tub w/ jets.  Store your bikes + car in your assigned exclusive use garage parking space. The common area roof deck offers expansive unobstructed views. Experience SF living at its best with easy access to local shops, restaurants, cafes & public transit. Make it yours today!
